Scoop.it is a simple and flexible content curation platform that allows you to engage your external or internal audiences with relevant information organized by themes.

Who is it for? Businesses, public organizations, educational institutions, associations, researchers or experts…

Scoop.it helps you capitalize on information.

1. Select

Scoop.it's advanced content engine monitors millions of sources worldwide to help you detect and select the best content.

Discover new sources, add the sources you typically follow or upload your own content.

2. Organize

Create your personalized, private or public topic pages to store relevant content.

Enrich each content with your expert analysis and tags to give it meaning and facilitate access to information for your team or community.

Animate your content hubs collaboratively to gain efficiency and time.

3. Share

Inform and engage your community with impactful, high-value content.

Feed your social networks with relevant content.

Integrate your intelligence on your website, blog, intranet, document portal.

Create, automate and send your personalized newsletters from Scoop.it.

Measure impact and ROI.

Ease of adoption

Interface used and approved by 8M users for over 15 years.

Security

A private space in your own colors for your team to share safely.

Scalable

Discover and publish as much content as you want, easily share with readers.

All-in-one

SaaS solution hosted in France with no deployment costs.

Integrated content solution

Content monitoring, newsletter creation, content integration and distribution from a single platform.

Governance

Administration of user rights and roles.

ROI

Measure the performance of content and teams, newsletter campaigns, content hubs. Exportable statistics.

Flexible

Integrated solution with multiple applications and technologies (API, SSO access, embed windows, RSS feeds, Microsoft Teams, Slack...). Connect Scoop.it to your AI assistants and applications to search, analyze and make the most of your curated content.
